title: Aye Mere Bezabaa tum rehgaye kaha
body:
Haye asghar, mere asghar..(2)
Aye raaj dulare asghar, maa tujhko pukare asghar
meri aankh ke taare asghar, aaja mere pyaare asghar
<<MINI>>
Aye mere be zabaa'n, tum reh gaye Kahaa'n
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehra wo chaand jaisa..(2)
kaise bhulai maa
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
Aye mere be zabaa'n, tum reh gaye Kahaa'n
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kyya waqt aagaya hai, bano ki bekasi par
Ghurbat pe tere matam, kaise karegi ki madar
Aada ne bandh di hain..(2)
hatho'n mein rassiya'n
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Himmat pe maa tumhari, qurbaan kyu na jaye
Sunti hu teer khakar, tum ran mein muskuraye
Maadar ki laaj rakh li..(2)
shabaash meri jaa'n
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maadar ki hai wasiyat, beta khayal rakhna
Godi mein inki Asghar, jane ki zidd na karna
Pehle hi hai shikasta..(2)
dadi ki pasliya'n
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kya zere khaak ab bhi, soye ho mu chupaye
Maa saari bibiyo'n se, sharminda ho na jaye
Har ek shaheed Ka hai..(2)
sar barsar e sina
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dushwar hogaya hai, ghum mein tumhare jeena
Ab khali god jaa kar, maa kya kare madina
Mujh ko wahi bula lo..(2)
aye laal ho jaha'n
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Haaye, Sansein to chal rahi hai, zinda kaha'n rahi hai
Maa Zindagi se apni, aazadi chahti hai
Mushkil khusha ho tum bhi, khulwado bediya'n
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Jungle mein ek beta, aawaz gunjti hai
Yeh soch kar bhi madar, maqtal mein ro rahi hai
Lagta hai dard se tum..(2)
lete ho siskiya'n
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Yeh ujdi god beta, kaise sukoon paaye
Haalat pe teri maa ki, haste hai shaam wale
Daaman mein hai tumhare..(2)
jhoole ki lakdiya'n
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Rote the sab takallum, ek maa ne jab Kaha tha
Paigham Karbala mein, jakar hawa yeh dena
Zindaa'n ke dar pe ab bhi..(2)
baithi hai ek maa
<<MINI>>
Asghar jiyegi kaise, tere baghair maa
